objective: Qualified demand and completed launch milestones

gtm-board-standup.expected_when: The routine is due and its scoped report, research or reconciliation has not been verified for the period.
gtm-board-standup.acceptance: A dated sourced finding, decision or reconciliation is usable by its intended reader.
gtm-board-standup.fallback: Reverify stale blockers, reconcile progress receipts and select the next authorized owned action. Surface delivery stalls separately from run failures.
gtm-board-standup.recovery: Refresh source facts and continue unfinished useful work in the current eligible period.
